task_text: 核查以下声明，搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：In 2013, on the 50th anniversary of Kenya’s independence, 2.33 million were connected to the power grid.（声明日期：2019-02-08）
task_text_en: Fact-check the following claim by searching for external evidence. Answer based on the evidence actually obtained, and state the scope of the conclusion and its uncertainties: In 2013, on the 50th anniversary of Kenya’s independence, 2.33 million were connected to the power grid. (claim date: 2019-02-08)
